cases.title: Verify Initial UI Elements and State on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the Tic Tac Toe webpage, the title, current player display with data-testid='current-player' showing 'Player X's turn', 9 empty tiles (data-testid='tile-1' to 'tile-9') without any player classes or inner text, and the reset button are correctly displayed.

cases.title: Valid Move Processing and Turn Alternation
cases.description: Verify that clicking an empty tile during an active game displays the current player's symbol, adds the correct CSS class ('playerX' or 'playerO'), and correctly switches the turn and updates the current player display element.

cases.title: Ignore Clicks on Occupied Tiles
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a tile that is already occupied does not alter the tile's content, classes, current player indicator, or game state, and applies consistently across all tiles.

cases.title: Win Condition Handling and Board Lock
cases.description: Verify that when a player wins, the announcer displays the correct win message ('Player X Won' or 'Player O Won') with the appropriate styling, the 'hide' class is removed from the announcer, and further board interactions are disabled.

cases.title: Tie Game Handling and Board Lock
cases.description: Verify that when the game ends in a tie after all 9 tiles are filled without a winner, the announcer displays 'Tie', the 'hide' class is removed from the announcer, and further board interactions are prevented.

cases.title: Reset Button Functionality Across Scenarios
cases.description: Verify that clicking the reset button clears all tiles, resets the internal state, hides the announcer section, and sets the current player back to 'X' across various game states (in progress, after win, after tie, or empty).

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements adequately, are distinct, testable, and present no blockers or risks.

analysis.analysis:
R-1: Testable behavior includes initial UI element presence (title, current-player display, tile-1 to tile-9, reset-button) and initial empty tile states (no inner text, no playerX/playerO classes). Boundaries: exactly 9 tiles. Normal path: load page and verify all elements. Abnormal path: missing required elements.
R-2 & R-7: Testable behavior includes valid move processing on empty tiles, symbol rendering ('X' or 'O'), CSS class assignment ('playerX' or 'playerO'), current player toggle, and display update ('Player X's turn' / 'Player O's turn'). Boundaries: turn alternation sequence (X -> O -> X). Normal path: click empty tile during active game. Abnormal path: clicking occupied tile or clicking when game is inactive.
R-3: Testable behavior includes ignoring clicks on occupied tiles. Boundaries: all tiles tile-1 through tile-9. Normal path: clicking an empty tile updates state. Abnormal path: clicking an occupied tile leaves innerText, classes, current player indicator, and game state (active/inactive/announcer) completely unchanged.
R-5: Testable behavior includes win detection, displaying 'Player X Won' or 'Player O Won' in data-testid='announcer' with correct styling/class, removing 'hide' class from announcer, and locking game board. Boundaries: minimum moves for win, winning on the last move. Normal path: completing a winning line. Abnormal path/ambiguity: interactions attempted after win must be blocked.
R-6: Testable behavior includes tie detection when all 9 tiles are filled without a winner, updating announcer to 'Tie', removing 'hide' class, and disabling board interaction. Boundaries: exactly the 9th move resulting in no winner. Normal path: fill board with no three-in-a-row.
R-8: Testable behavior includes resetting the board, clearing all tiles (tile-1 to tile-9), hiding the announcer section, and resetting current player to X. Boundaries/Scenarios: reset when empty, in progress, after win, after tie. Normal path: click reset-button at any game phase.
